# Add a task

**The finished shape:** `src/main/java/com/quavo/tests/pages/resources/` (the page, its elements and actions) and `src/test/java/com/quavo/tests/cases/ResourcesFormTest.java`, the suite's worked example (README.md, "Write a test"). What follows is only what to add.

A task is a sequence a story names as one thing: "sign up", "log in", "check out". It goes in the
page's Tasks class (`TrustedByTasks`), YOURS block **tasks**, and is reached with `execute()`:

```java
    public ThanksPage signUp(String email) {
        TrustedByPage here = new TrustedByPage(page);
        here.enter().email(email);
        here.check().terms();
        return here.click().submit();
    }
```

Then the test says `new TrustedByPage(page).open("issuing-banks").execute().signUp("pat@example.com").verify().showsThanks();`

Build tasks only from the page's own actions, so every step is logged once and named once. A
task that crosses pages returns the page it ends on.
